title: Seagrove Beach "Summer by the Sea" 4341 E County Hwy 30A Unit B401
h1: Seagrove Beach "Summer by the Sea" 4341 E County Hwy 30A Unit B401
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Community pool- Balcony- Elevator- 2 Parking spots- Smart TVs- 3 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: A tranquil escape awaits at Villas at Seagrove, a delightful 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo that comfortably sleeps 6 guests in beautiful Seagrove Beach. Nestled a short walk from the soft white-sand beach and sparkling Gulf waters, this condo is the perfect retreat for small groups and couples looking for a relaxing beach getaway. Guests will love spending afternoons swimming at the community pool or taking advantage of the many family-friendly activities offered in this quintessential beach town.A peaceful interior swathed in crisp whites and sky blues, with hints of gold and coastal shiplap walls, sets the scene inside this single-story condo for an enchanting vacation. The spacious great room begins with a gourmet kitchen featuring granite countertops, high-end appliances, and an island that doubles as a 3-stool breakfast bar. Enjoy sunlit mornings chatting with friends and families while whipping up omelets and packing coolers for the beach. Steps away, a wood-and-wicker dining set has room for 8 to dine on homemade meals. Turn into the seamlessly connected living space where 2 cushy armchairs and a corner sofa face a Smart TV, inviting guests to curl up with bowls of buttery popcorn for a casual movie night. When the outdoors calls, mix up a pitcher of sangria and slip out the double glass doors off the living and dining areas to enjoy the sea air from the furnished balcony. At the evening’s end, guests can retire to any of the 3 exquisite guest bedrooms, each with a plush king bed, for a restful night.Charming accommodations and beach access a quick 3-minute walk away make Villas at Seagrove a marvelous Seagrove Beach retreat. Exploring is easy with parking for 2 vehicles and 3 complimentary adult bikes. The nearest beach access is at Majestica Beach. Book this lovely condo today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 6):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.*Rules and regulations for The Villas at Seagrove Beach.Please be respectful of your neighbors by observing quiet times before 8 AM and after 10 PM. Any excessive noise after 10 PM is a violation of the Walton County noise ordinance (Ord.2014-16 sec.5) and may result in a citation, fine or loss of security deposit.*No pets. Renters who bring pets may incur a fine to unit owner and loss of security deposit for renters.*Each unit is allotted no more than two vehicles, including golf carts. ONLY gas powered golf carts are permitted. Electric golf carts are strictly prohibited.*No smoking in elevators, lobbies, pool areas, or on balconies.*Bikes are only to be parked in bike racks.*Pool hours are from 8 AM to 10 PM. Children under the age of 16 must be accompanied by an adult. No food or glass containers are allowed in the pool area. Radios/ Speakers are not prohibited in the pool area.
